network: Cannot reach the relay. Check that it is running and that the console address is right.
unauthenticated: Session expired — please sign in again
csrf: Rejected by CSRF protection; refresh and retry
conflict: Conflicts with an existing object (duplicate name or port already taken)
token_used: This join token was already used
internal: Relay internal error — see the log on the diagnostics page
misdirected: Host header not allowed (DNS rebinding protection)
notImplemented: This endpoint does not exist in the current relay build (the console keeps the entry point per spec)
contractMismatch: Console version does not match the relay

eventKind.tunnel_stream_denied: Target denied by agent policy (at dial time)
